SPQR V1: braid state machine and incremental ML-KEM-768 (src/incremental_mlkem768.rs, src/v1/)

Trusted in part. The theorems of Computational/Theorems/ use only part of this file (see Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md): the rest is mostly the camelCase aliases (fromPb / intoPb), model-only helpers (SharedSecret, KeyPair, decapsulate, validate_pk, States.epoch), the self-test stubs (stubMlKem, stubPolyApi, stubAuthApi, StubEncoder, StubDecoder), and the check* / guard_* test drivers (guard_issue1275, guard_message_serialize, guard_full_braid_and_pb_roundtrip, guard_panics_and_errors), all checked by Lean.

Models SPQR V1 sparse continuous key agreement (SCKA) over abstract MlKem, erasure-coding PolyApi, and authenticator/KDF AuthApi, with explicit panic/error outcomes (StatesPanic, StatesError, StatesResult):

  • src/incremental_mlkem768.rs: Keys, generate, encaps1, encaps2, decaps, ek_matches_header (validate_pk_bytes), potentially_fix_state_incorrectly_encoded_by_libcrux_issue_1275, and flip_endianness_of_encapsulation_state.

  • src/v1/unchunked/{send_ek, send_ct}: unchunked states (KeysUnsampled, HeaderSent, EkSent, EkSentCt1Received; NoHeaderReceived, HeaderReceived, Ct1Sent, Ct1SentEkReceived, Ct2Sent), transitions (send_ek, ...), and into_pb / from_pb.

  • src/v1/chunked/: the 11-variant States braid machine (States.init_a, States.init_b, States.send -> V1Send, States.recv -> V1Recv, States.into_pb, States.from_pb) and SCKA wire messages (MessagePayload, Message, MessageType, Message.serialize, Message.deserialize).

Swap adjacent byte pairs (b0, b1) ↦ (b1, b0).

def swapAdjacentPairs : Bytes → Bytes | b0 :: b1 :: rest => b1 :: b0 :: swapAdjacentPairs rest | xs => xs

def flipEndiannessOfEncapsulationStateBytesL242–245 ↗#

Swap each 2-byte pair in es[0 .. es.len() - 32], leaving the trailing 32-byte randomness unchanged.

def flipEndiannessOfEncapsulationStateBytes (es : EncapsulationState) : EncapsulationState := let prefixLen := es.length - 32 swapAdjacentPairs (es.take prefixLen) ++ es.drop prefixLen

def flip_endianness_of_encapsulation_stateL247–253 ↗#

flip_endianness_of_encapsulation_state (src/incremental_mlkem768.rs:143–153).

def flip_endianness_of_encapsulation_state (es : EncapsulationState) : Except StatesPanic EncapsulationState := if es.length % 2 != 0 || !(es.length > 32) then .error (.flipEndiannessBadLen es.length) else .ok (flipEndiannessOfEncapsulationStateBytes es)

def issue1275NeedsFlipL255–269 ↗#

Scan es[1536..2048] in 2-byte LE words (src/incremental_mlkem768.rs:117–137): skip 0/-1, return false on valid LE (1, 2, 0xFFFE), true on byte-swapped BE (0x0100, 0x0200, 0xFEFF), and false otherwise.

def issue1275NeedsFlip : Bytes → Bool | b0 :: b1 :: rest => let w : BitVec 16 := (b1.zeroExtend 16 <<< 8) ||| b0.zeroExtend 16 if w == 0x0000#16 || w == 0xFFFF#16 then issue1275NeedsFlip rest else if w == 0x0001#16 || w == 0x0002#16 || w == 0xFFFE#16 then false else if w == 0x0100#16 || w == 0x0200#16 || w == 0xFEFF#16 then true else false | _ => false

def potentially_fix_state_incorrectly_encoded_by_libcrux_issue_1275L279–291 ↗#

potentially_fix_state_incorrectly_encoded_by_libcrux_issue_1275 (src/incremental_mlkem768.rs:92–138), checking es.len() == 2080.

def potentially_fix_state_incorrectly_encoded_by_libcrux_issue_1275 (es : EncapsulationState) : Except StatesPanic (Option EncapsulationState) := if es.length != ENCAPSULATION_STATE_SIZE then .error (.issue1275BadLen es.length) else let error2Bytes := (es.drop 1536).take (2080 - 32 - 1536) if issue1275NeedsFlip error2Bytes then do let fixed ← flip_endianness_of_encapsulation_state es .ok (some fixed) else .ok none

def generateL302–309 ↗#

generate (src/incremental_mlkem768.rs:34–43): consumes 64 seed bytes from tape.

def generate (K : MlKem) (tape : Bytes) : Except StatesPanic (Keys × Bytes) := match bytesToVector? KEY_GENERATION_SEED_SIZE (tape.take KEY_GENERATION_SEED_SIZE) with | none => .error (.rngExhausted KEY_GENERATION_SEED_SIZE tape.length) | some seed => let (hdr, ek, dk) := K.fromSeed seed .ok ({ ek := ek.toList, dk := dk.toList, hdr := hdr.toList }, tape.drop KEY_GENERATION_SEED_SIZE)

def encaps1L311–321 ↗#

encaps1 (src/incremental_mlkem768.rs:48–66): consumes 32 random bytes from tape and panics if K.encaps1 returns none.

def encaps1 (K : MlKem) (hdr : Header) (tape : Bytes) : Except StatesPanic ((Ciphertext1 × EncapsulationState × Secret) × Bytes) := match bytesToVector? SHARED_SECRET_SIZE (tape.take SHARED_SECRET_SIZE) with | none => .error (.rngExhausted SHARED_SECRET_SIZE tape.length) | some rand => match K.encaps1 hdr rand with | none => .error .encaps1Failed | some (ct1, es, ss) => .ok ((ct1.toList, es.toList, ss.toList), tape.drop SHARED_SECRET_SIZE)

def encaps2L323–330 ↗#

def encaps2 (K : MlKem) (ek : EncapsulationKey) (es : EncapsulationState) : Except StatesPanic Ciphertext2 := do let maybeFix ← potentially_fix_state_incorrectly_encoded_by_libcrux_issue_1275 es let es' := maybeFix.getD es match bytesToVector? ENCAPSULATION_STATE_SIZE es', bytesToVector? ENCAPSULATION_KEY_SIZE ek with | some esVec, some ekVec => .ok (K.encaps2 esVec ekVec).toList | _, _ => .error (.encaps2BadSize es'.length ek.length)
